question:
There is a spelling error in the given sentence. Select the option that contains the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

He was in despare because of the expiry of his licence.
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"despare" is* incorrectly spelt*.** The **correct spelling is "despair,"** which means **a complete loss or absence of hope.** (निराशा)

 
 
• **Example: **He was in** despair** after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"despair"** which means a state in which all hope is lost or absent. (निराशा)
 
 
• **Example: **Their team was in **despair** after losing the championship game.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is** 'despair.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Expiry** (समाप्ति): The end of a period for which something is valid.

 
 
• **Example:** The** expiry **date on the milk carton is tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **Because** (क्योंकि): For the reason that; since.
 
 
• **Example:** She was late** because **of the traffic jam.
 
 
 
• **Licence** (लाइसेंस): An official permission or permit to do, use, or own something.
 
 
• **Example:** He needs to renew his driving **licence.**
